description: An envelope generator for drums that runs a whole attack, decay, sustain and release cycle from one trigger, with every stage given its own length in seconds.

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to climb from 0V to its peak, from 0.001 to 4.999 seconds.
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from its peak to the sustain level, from 0.001 to 4.999 seconds.
Sets how long the envelope holds at the sustain level before it releases, from 0.001 to 4.999 seconds.
Sets the level the envelope holds at, as a fraction of the 5V peak; the value is clamped to 0.99, so the upper part of the knob gives one level and the panel's 0 to 5 marking is wrong.
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from the sustain level to 0V, from 0.001 to 4.999 seconds.
Chooses a straight line or a quarter-sine curve for that stage; the panel prints EXP for the curve, which is a sine rather than an exponential.

inputs.text: Starts the envelope from 0V each time the voltage rises through 0.5V.
Adds to the attack time, 10V covering the whole 0.001 to 4.999 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the decay time, 10V covering the whole 0.001 to 4.999 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the sustain time, 10V covering the whole 0.001 to 4.999 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the sustain level, 10V covering the 0.01 to 0.99 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the release time, 10V covering the whole 0.001 to 4.999 second span, with the total clamped to it.

notes: the envelope runs its whole shape from a trigger rather than from the length of a gate: the sustain stage has a time of its own, and the release follows it however long the gate stays high.
